levels.label: Hardened
levels.criteria: All 24 critical items passed AND ≥80% recommended items

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.criteria: All 24 critical items passed AND <80% recommended items

scoring.evaluate: function(checked, items) { const critical = items.filter(i => i.critical); const recommended = items.filter(i => !i.critical); const criticalDone = critical.filter(i => checked[i.id]).length; const criticalMissing = critical.length - criticalDone; const recDone = recommended.filter(i => checked[i.id]).length; const recPct = recommended.length > 0 ? recDone / recommended.length : 1; if (criticalMissing === 0 && recPct >= 0.8) return 'hardened'; if (criticalMissing === 0) return 'acceptable'; if (criticalMissing <= 5) return 'at_risk'; return 'critical'; }

categories.title: API Surface & Exposure
categories.subtitle: Lilli lesson: 22 unauthenticated endpoints were the entry point

items.label: Complete endpoint inventory
items.detail: All publicly reachable endpoints documented. Run: nmap + API doc scan on host IP
items.check_command: nmap -sV <host-ip> && curl -s http://<host>/docs

items.label: No publicly exposed API documentation
items.detail: Swagger/OpenAPI docs were the entry point at Lilli. Check /docs, /swagger, /openapi.json, /redoc, /api-docs
items.check_command: for path in /docs /swagger /openapi.json /redoc /api-docs; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $path\n" http://<host>$path; done

items.label: All endpoints require authentication
items.detail: Including health checks that may leak internal info. Test each endpoint without auth token
items.check_command: curl -s -H 'Authorization: ' http://<host>/api/v1/<endpoint> | head -20

items.label: Rate limiting on all endpoints
items.detail: Without rate limiting, an agent can probe hundreds of endpoints per second
items.check_command: for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://<host>/api/health; done | sort | uniq -c

items.label: Error responses don't leak internals
items.detail: No stack traces, DB schemas, or internal paths in error responses
items.check_command: curl -s -X POST http://<host>/api/v1/search -d '{"invalid'

categories.title: Injection & Input Validation
categories.subtitle: Lilli lesson: JSON keys concatenated directly into SQL

items.label: All DB queries fully parameterized
items.detail: Including field names, sort orders, table names — not just values. At Lilli, values were safe but keys were not
items.check_command: grep -rn 'f".*SELECT\|f".*INSERT\|f".*UPDATE\|format.*SELECT\|%s.*SELECT' --include='*.py' .

items.label: External input sanitized before tool/DB forwarding
items.detail: Messages from WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack/webhooks sanitized before passing to MCP tools or databases
items.check_command: # Review: How does messaging input flow through to DB/tool calls?

items.label: Allowlist for dynamic query field names
items.detail: No user-controlled keys in SQL/NoSQL. Maintain explicit allowlist of valid field names
items.check_command: # Review: Are there places where request.body keys flow into queries?

items.label: MCP tool responses validated for prompt injection
items.detail: Tool responses can contain crafted content that manipulates AI behavior. Treat all tool responses as untrusted
items.check_command: # Review: Are MCP tool responses validated/sanitized before AI processes them?

items.label: No differential error responses enabling schema enumeration
items.detail: CodeWall's agent used blind error-based probing. Uniform errors for 'not found' vs 'query error'
items.check_command: # Test: Do malformed queries return different error codes/messages?

categories.title: Prompt & Skill Integrity
categories.subtitle: Lilli lesson: System prompts in same DB as user data — writable

items.label: System prompts/config under version control
items.detail: Protected branches, no direct push to main. Changes require PR review
items.check_command: git log --oneline -5 -- CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md && git config branch.main.protection

items.label: Write-protection hook for config files
items.detail: PreToolUse hook blocks automated writes to SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or equivalent
items.check_command: cat ~/.claude/settings.json | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d.get('hooks',{}), indent=2))"

items.label: Prompt integrity hash verification
items.detail: SHA256 hashes compared at startup or in CI. See examples/ci/prompt-integrity-check.sh
items.check_command: sha256sum CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md skills/*.md 2>/dev/null

items.label: Prompt storage separated from user data
items.detail: System prompts NOT in the same DB as user data — this was the core Lilli problem
items.check_command: # Review: Where are config files stored? Same access path as user data?

items.label: Skill activation only through manual config
items.detail: New skills cannot be dynamically activated by user input or MCP responses
items.check_command: # Review: Can an agent create and activate new SKILL.md files via tool calls?

categories.title: Cross-User Isolation
categories.subtitle: Lilli lesson: IDOR allowed access to other employees' search histories

items.label: User data strictly separated
items.detail: Cross-platform/cross-tenant isolation. Telegram user cannot access WhatsApp conversations of another user
items.check_command: # Review: How are user sessions separated across platforms?

items.label: No sequential or predictable IDs
items.detail: UUIDs or equivalent. Sequential IDs (user_1, user_2) enable trivial enumeration
items.check_command: # Review: Check user/session/resource ID formats in codebase

items.label: RAG queries enforce user/tenant filters
items.detail: Mandatory where-clause for user/tenant in all data queries. Enforced at data layer, not app layer
items.check_command: # Review: Is there a mandatory tenant filter in all RAG/data queries?

items.label: Session tokens cryptographically secure
items.detail: Cryptographically random, sufficient length. Not derived from user-visible info
items.check_command: # Review: How are sessions generated and validated?

categories.title: Secrets Management
categories.subtitle: Prevent agent access to credentials and API keys

items.label: No .env in workspace root or agent-accessible paths
items.detail: AI agents can read files in working directory. Secrets files must not be present
items.check_command: find . -name '.env*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null

items.label: Vault references instead of plaintext secrets
items.detail: Use op:// (1Password), vault: (HashiCorp), or equivalent — never plaintext keys
items.check_command: grep -rn 'sk-\|AKIA\|ghp_\|xoxb-\|xoxp-' .env* *.env 2>/dev/null

items.label: PreToolUse hook blocks .env access
items.detail: settings.json deny-rules are unreliable (GitHub Issue #6699). PreToolUse hooks are the only dependable protection
items.check_command: cat ~/.claude/settings.json | python3 -c "import sys,json; h=json.load(sys.stdin).get('hooks',{}); [print(k,v) for k,v in h.items() if 'PreTool' in k]"

items.label: .claude/settings.json in .gitignore
items.detail: Prevents accidental commit of settings including hook configurations
items.check_command: grep '.claude' .gitignore

items.label: Sensitive paths blocked via hook
items.detail: Block agent read/edit on ~/.ssh/, *.pem, *.key, credentials.json, service-account.json
items.check_command: # Check if PreToolUse hook includes sensitive paths in blocklist

categories.title: MCP Server Security
categories.subtitle: Tool protocol security and server trust boundaries

items.label: enableAllProjectMcpServers is false or unset
items.detail: true = auto-run any MCP server found in project config. Equivalent to running untrusted code
items.check_command: cat ~/.claude/settings.json | grep 'enableAll'

items.label: Only explicitly allowlisted MCP servers active
items.detail: Vetted and explicitly enabled servers only
items.check_command: cat ~/.claude/settings.json | grep -A 10 'enabledMcp'

items.label: Each MCP server assessed for prompt injection risk
items.detail: Tool responses processed by AI can contain crafted content that manipulates behavior
items.check_command: # Review: List all active servers and their tool response types

items.label: Remote MCP servers not publicly reachable
items.detail: Use VPN, SSH tunnels, or private networking. Not directly exposed to internet
items.check_command: # Test: nmap <remote-host-ip> from external network

items.label: MCP transport encrypted
items.detail: TLS for HTTP/SSE connections. stdio for local is inherently secure
items.check_command: # Check: Are MCP connections over stdio (local) or HTTP? If HTTP: TLS active?

categories.title: Isolation & Sandboxing
categories.subtitle: Contain blast radius of compromised agents

items.label: AI tool runs under standard user account
items.detail: No admin/root. Principle of least privilege
items.check_command: whoami && groups $USER

items.label: Untrusted repos opened in containers/VMs
items.detail: Never open unknown repositories directly on the host
items.check_command: ls .devcontainer/ 2>/dev/null

items.label: Container hardening active
items.detail: Mount /dev/null over .env in devcontainer: -v /dev/null:/workspace/.env
items.check_command: cat .devcontainer/devcontainer.json 2>/dev/null | grep 'null'

items.label: SSH keys excluded from agent access
items.detail: PreToolUse hook blocks access to ~/.ssh/
items.check_command: # Check if hook blocklist includes ~/.ssh/

items.label: PreToolUse bash firewall hook active
items.detail: Blocks rm -rf, external curl, pipe-to-shell. See examples/hooks/pretool-bash-firewall.sh
items.check_command: cat ~/.claude/settings.json | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(json.dumps(v,indent=2)) for k,v in d.get('hooks',{}).items()]" 2>/dev/null | head -40

items.label: Write-protection extended to prompt/config files
items.detail: Not just secrets — also SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md. See examples/hooks/pretool-write-protection.sh
items.check_command: # Check if hook protected-file list includes config files

items.label: HITL protocol formalized as security gate
items.detail: Explicit thresholds: which actions are NEVER allowed without human confirmation? (>5 file deletes, public API changes, DB migrations, secrets access)
items.check_command: # Review: Is there a documented clarification protocol with defined thresholds?

items.label: Audit logging for all tool calls
items.detail: Forensic trail for incident analysis. See examples/hooks/pretool-audit-logger.sh
items.check_command: # Check if a logging hook exists or audit_level is set

items.label: Hook matchers precise, not wildcard
items.detail: Wildcard * processes every tool call. Use specific matchers (Bash, Edit|Write) for performance
items.check_command: # Review hook matcher patterns for precision vs coverage balance

items.label: AI tool on current version
items.detail: Known CVEs (e.g. CVE-2025-55284) patched in newer versions. Update regularly
items.check_command: claude --version && npm list -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

items.label: npm/pip lifecycle scripts disabled
items.detail: postinstall scripts can execute arbitrary code. npm config set ignore-scripts true
items.check_command: npm config get ignore-scripts

items.label: No PII/PHI/production data in agent context
items.detail: Never load customer data, PII, or PHI into AI agent sessions
items.check_command: # Policy review: Are production data files loaded into Claude sessions?

items.label: Transcript retention limited
items.detail: Session transcripts may contain secrets. Limit to 7–14 days
items.check_command: ls -la ~/.claude/transcripts/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l

items.label: Monthly settings audit process
items.detail: Check settings.json for drift. CI pipeline or calendar reminder
items.check_command: # Does a recurring security config review exist?
